# Draft note

## When to use

Use this when a fictional note needs a clear explanation and next action.

## Outcome

Produce one concise draft with a concrete example and a clear next action.

## Inputs

Read the agreed scope, intended audience and the fictional source material.

## Procedure

Write a short draft, remove unnecessary detail, and compare it to the agreed clarity criterion.

## Completion

Return the draft and any unresolved questions for review without publishing it.
